list.title: Sudoku Generator and Solver
list.description: A Java based Sudoku generator, solvable and playable game. Recursive Backtracking and greedy iterative algorithms are used to generate puzzles across three difficulty levels. Three cell-removal strategies ranked against runtime and probability of generating a uniquely solvable Sudoku puzzle to justify which option use in the generator. See the report here: [report.pdf](https://github.com/tobiayodele/Sudoku/blob/experiments/docs/report_cell_removal_methods.pdf)
